blaze.short: Strengthens Fire moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

overgrow.short: Strengthens Grass moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

torrent.short: Strengthens Water moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

shield-dust.short: Protects against incoming moves' extra effects.

rain-dish.short: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during rain.

swarm.short: Strengthens Bug moves to inflict 1.5× damage at 1/3 max HP or less.

tinted-lens.short: Doubles damage inflicted with not-very-effective moves.

sniper.short: Strengthens critical hits to inflict 3× damage rather than 2×.

solar-power.short: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× but costs 1/8 max HP after each turn during strong sunlight.

run-away.short: Ensures success fleeing from wild battles.

shed-skin.short: Has a 33% chance of curing any major status ailment after each turn.

rivalry.short: Increases damage inflicted to 1.25× against Pokémon of the same gender, but decreases damage to 0.75× against the opposite gender.

intimidate.short: Lowers opponents' Attack one stage upon entering battle.

unaware.short: Ignores other Pokémon's stat modifiers for damage and accuracy calculation.

unnerve.short: Prevents opposing Pokémon from eating held Berries.

static.short: Has a 30% chance of paralyzing attacking Pokémon on contact.

lightning-rod.short: Redirects single-target Electric moves to this Pokémon where possible. Absorbs Electric moves, raising Special Attack one stage.

magic-guard.short: Protects against damage not directly caused by a move.

flash-fire.short: Protects against Fire moves. Once one has been blocked, the Pokémon's own Fire moves inflict 1.5× damage until it leaves battle.

sand-veil.short: Increases evasion to 1.25× during a sandstorm. Protects against sandstorm damage.

guts.short: Increases Attack to 1.5× with a major status ailment.

sheer-force.short: Strengthens moves with extra effects to 1.3× their power, but prevents their extra effects.

friend-guard.short: Decreases all direct damage taken by friendly Pokémon to 0.75×.

poison-point.short: Has a 30% chance of poisoning attacking Pokémon on contact.

cute-charm.short: Has a 30% chance of infatuating attacking Pokémon on contact.

hustle.short: Strengthens physical moves to inflict 1.5× damage, but decreases their accuracy to 0.8×.

sand-rush.short: Doubles Speed during a sandstorm. Protects against sandstorm damage.

competitive.short: Raises Special Attack by two stages upon having any stat lowered.

infiltrator.short: Bypasses Light Screen, Reflect, and Safeguard.

drought.short: Summons strong sunlight that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.

frisk.short: Reveals an opponent's held item upon entering battle.

pickup.short: Picks up other Pokémon's used and Flung held items. May also pick up an item after battle.

cloud-nine.short: Negates all effects of weather, but does not prevent the weather itself.

arena-trap.short: Prevents opponents from fleeing or switching out. Eluded by Flying-types and Pokémon in the air.

effect-spore.short: Has a 30% chance of inflcting either paralysis, poison, or sleep on attacking Pokémon on contact.

sand-force.short: Strengthens Rock, Ground, and Steel moves to 1.3× their power during a sandstorm. Protects against sandstorm damage.

damp.short: Prevents Self-Destruct, Explosion, and Aftermath from working while the Pokémon is in battle.

wonder-skin.short: Lowers incoming non-damaging moves' base accuracy to exactly 50%.

stench.short: Has a 10% chance of making target Pokémon flinch with each hit.

dry-skin.short: Causes 1/8 max HP in damage each turn during strong sunlight, but heals for 1/8 max HP during rain. Increases damage from Fire moves to 1.25×, but absorbs Water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.

technician.short: Strengthens moves of 60 base power or less to 1.5× their power.

anger-point.short: Raises Attack to the maximum of six stages upon receiving a critical hit.

flame-body.short: Has a 30% chance of burning attacking Pokémon on contact.

justified.short: Raises Attack one stage upon taking damage from a Dark move.

sturdy.short: Prevents being KOed from full HP, leaving 1 HP instead. Protects against the one-hit KO moves regardless of HP.

no-guard.short: Ensures all moves used by and against the Pokémon hit.

liquid-ooze.short: Damages opponents using leeching moves for as much as they would heal.

defiant.short: Raises Attack two stages upon having any stat lowered.

synchronize.short: Copies burns, paralysis, and poison received onto the Pokémon that inflicted them.

water-absorb.short: Absorbs Water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.

gluttony.short: Makes the Pokémon eat any held Berry triggered by low HP below 1/2 its max HP.

clear-body.short: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.

oblivious.short: Prevents infatuation and protects against Captivate.

steadfast.short: Raises Speed one stage upon flinching.

cursed-body.short: Has a 30% chance of Disabling any move that hits the Pokémon.

sticky-hold.short: Prevents a held item from being removed by other Pokémon.

weak-armor.short: Raises Speed and lowers Defense by one stage each upon being hit by a physical move.

analytic.short: Strengthens moves to 1.3× their power when moving last.

early-bird.short: Makes sleep pass twice as quickly.

hydration.short: Cures any major status ailment after each turn during rain.

poison-touch.short: Has a 30% chance of poisoning target Pokémon upon contact.

skill-link.short: Extends two-to-five-hit moves and Triple Kick to their full length every time.

thick-fat.short: Halves damage from Fire and Ice moves.

ice-body.short: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during hail. Protects against hail damage.

magnet-pull.short: Prevents Steel opponents from fleeing or switching out.

regenerator.short: Heals for 1/3 max HP upon switching out.

aftermath.short: Damages the attacker for 1/4 its max HP when knocked out by a contact move.

hyper-cutter.short: Prevents Attack from being lowered by other Pokémon.

scrappy.short: Lets the Pokémon's Normal and Fighting moves hit Ghost Pokémon.

forewarn.short: Reveals the opponents' strongest move upon entering battle.

unburden.short: Doubles Speed upon using or losing a held item.

iron-fist.short: Strengthens punch-based moves to 1.2× their power.

reckless.short: Strengthens recoil moves to 1.2× their power.

harvest.short: Has a 50% chance of restoring a used Berry after each turn if the Pokémon has held no items in the meantime.

healer.short: Has a 30% chance of curing each adjacent ally of any major status ailment after each turn.

serene-grace.short: Doubles the chance of moves' extra effects occurring.

natural-cure.short: Cures any major status ailment upon switching out.

neutralizing-gas.short: Neutralizes abilities of all Pokémon in battle.

leaf-guard.short: Protects against major status ailments during strong sunlight.

download.short: Raises the attack stat corresponding to the opponents' weaker defense one stage upon entering battle.

pressure.short: Increases the PP cost of moves targetting the Pokémon by one.

anticipation.short: Notifies all trainers upon entering battle if an opponent has a super-effective move, Self-Destruct, Explosion, or a one-hit KO move.

volt-absorb.short: Absorbs Electric moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.

quick-feet.short: Increases Speed to 1.5× with a major status ailment.

trace.short: Copies an opponent's ability upon entering battle.

rattled.short: Raises Speed one stage upon being hit by a Dark, Ghost, or Bug move.

adaptability.short: Increases the same-type attack bonus from 1.5× to 2×.

snow-cloak.short: Increases evasion to 1.25× during hail. Protects against hail damage.

moxie.short: Raises Attack one stage upon KOing a Pokémon.

mold-breaker.short: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent a move.

filter.short: Decreases damage taken from super-effective moves by 1/4.

plus.short: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× when a friendly Pokémon has Plus or Minus.

multiscale.short: Halves damage taken from full HP.

super-luck.short: Raises moves' critical hit rates one stage.

marvel-scale.short: Increases Defense to 1.5× with a major status ailment.

magic-bounce.short: Reflects most non-damaging moves back at their user.

prankster.short: Raises non-damaging moves' priority by one stage.

shadow-tag.short: Prevents opponents from fleeing or switching out.

pickpocket.short: Steals attacking Pokémon's held items on contact.

drizzle.short: Summons rain that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.

speed-boost.short: Raises Speed one stage after each turn.

sap-sipper.short: Absorbs Grass moves, raising Attack one stage.

honey-gather.short: The Pokémon may pick up Honey after battle.

telepathy.short: Protects against friendly Pokémon's damaging moves.

simple.short: Doubles the Pokémon's stat modifiers. These doubled modifiers are still capped at -6 or 6 stages.

suction-cups.short: Prevents being forced out of battle by other Pokémon's moves.

rough-skin.short: Damages attacking Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP on contact.

poison-heal.short: Heals for 1/8 max HP after each turn when poisoned in place of damage.

wonder-guard.short: Protects against damaging moves that are not super effective.

moody.short: Raises a random stat two stages and lowers another one stage after each turn.

solid-rock.short: Decreases damage taken from super-effective moves by 1/4.

sand-stream.short: Summons a sandstorm that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.

stall.short: Makes the Pokémon move last within its move's priority bracket.

wind-rider.short: Gives immunity to wind moves, and causes the Pokémon's Attack to increase by one stage when hit by one.

normalize.short: Makes the Pokémon's moves all act Normal-type.

minus.short: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× when a friendly Pokémon has Plus or Minus.

motor-drive.short: Absorbs Electric moves, raising Speed one stage.

storm-drain.short: Redirects single-target Water moves to this Pokémon where possible. Absorbs Water moves, raising Special Attack one stage.

white-smoke.short: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.

heatproof.short: Halves damage from Fire moves and burns.

protean.short: Changes the bearer's type to match each move it uses.

forecast.short: Changes Castform's type and form to match the weather.

air-lock.short: Negates all effects of weather, but does not prevent the weather itself.

klutz.short: Prevents the Pokémon from using its held item in battle.

snow-warning.short: Summons hail that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.

bad-dreams.short: Damages sleeping opponents for 1/8 their max HP after each turn.

slow-start.short: Halves Attack and Speed for five turns upon entering battle.

color-change.short: Changes type to match when hit by a damaging move.

flower-gift.short: Increases friendly Pokémon's Attack and Special Defense to 1.5× during strong sunlight.

flare-boost.short: Increases Special Attack to 1.5× when burned.

bulletproof.short: Protects against bullet, ball, and bomb-based moves.

flower-veil.short: Protects friendly Grass Pokémon from having their stats lowered by other Pokémon.

zen-mode.short: Changes Darmanitan's form after each turn depending on its HP: Zen Mode below 50% max HP, and Standard Mode otherwise.

victory-star.short: Increases moves' accuracy to 1.1× for friendly Pokémon.

cheek-pouch.short: Restores HP upon eating a Berry, in addition to the Berry's effect.

iron-barbs.short: Damages attacking Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP on contact.

multitype.short: Changes Arceus's type and form to match its held Plate.

turboblaze.short: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent moves.

slush-rush.short: During Hail, this Pokémon has double Speed.

illusion.short: Takes the appearance of the last conscious party Pokémon upon being sent out until hit by a damaging move.

magician.short: Steals the target's held item when the bearer uses a damaging move.

symbiosis.short: Passes the bearer's held item to an ally when the ally uses up its item.

defeatist.short: Halves Attack and Special Attack at 50% max HP or less.

mummy.short: Changes attacking Pokémon's abilities to Mummy on contact.

gale-wings.short: Raises Flying moves' priority by one stage.

teravolt.short: Bypasses targets' abilities if they could hinder or prevent moves.

pixilate.short: Turns the bearer's Normal moves into Fairy moves and strengthens them to 1.3× their power.

dark-aura.short: Strengthens Dark moves to 1.33× their power for all friendly and opposing Pokémon.

long-reach.short: This Pokémon's moves do not make contact.

mega-launcher.short: Strengthens aura and pulse moves to 1.5× their power.

gooey.short: Lowers attacking Pokémon's Speed by one stage on contact.

aura-break.short: Makes Dark Aura and Fairy Aura weaken moves of their respective types.

tough-claws.short: Strengthens moves that make contact to 1.33× their power.

fairy-aura.short: Strengthens Fairy moves to 1.33× their power for all friendly and opposing Pokémon.

stance-change.short: Changes Aegislash to Blade Forme before using a damaging move, or Shield Forme before using King’s Shield.

strong-jaw.short: Strengthens biting moves to 1.5× their power.

grass-pelt.short: Boosts Defense while Grassy Terrain is in effect.

aroma-veil.short: Protects allies against moves that affect their mental state.

refrigerate.short: Turns the bearer's Normal moves into Ice moves and strengthens them to 1.3× their power.

wimp-out.short: This Pokémon automatically switches out when its HP drops below half.

queenly-majesty.short: Opposing Pokémon cannot use priority attacks.

emergency-exit.short: This Pokémon automatically switches out when its HP drops below half.

merciless.short: This Pokémon's moves critical hit against poisoned targets.

battery.short: Ally Pokémon's moves have their power increased to 1.3×.

water-compaction.short: Raises this Pokémon's Defense by two stages when it's hit by a Water move.

fluffy.short: Damage from contact moves is halved. Damage from Fire moves is doubled.

corrosion.short: This Pokémon can inflict poison on Poison and Steel Pokémon.

stakeout.short: This Pokémon's moves have double power against Pokémon that switched in this turn.

water-bubble.short: Halves damage from Fire moves, doubles damage of Water moves, and prevents burns.

stamina.short: Raises this Pokémon's Defense by one stage when it takes damage from a move.

triage.short: This Pokémon's healing moves have their priority increased by 3.

innards-out.short: When this Pokémon faints from an opponent's move, that opponent takes damage equal to the HP this Pokémon had remaining.

dancer.short: Whenever another Pokémon uses a dance move, this Pokémon will use the same move immediately afterwards.

schooling.short: Wishiwashi becomes Schooling Form when its HP is 25% or higher.

receiver.short: When an ally faints, this Pokémon gains its Ability.

shadow-shield.short: When this Pokémon has full HP, regular damage from moves is halved.

berserk.short: Raises this Pokémon's Special Attack by one stage every time its HP drops below half.

shields-down.short: Transforms this Minior between Core Form and Meteor Form. Prevents major status ailments and drowsiness while in Meteor Form.

grassy-surge.short: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Grassy Terrain.

psychic-surge.short: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Psychic Terrain.

comatose.short: This Pokémon always acts as though it were Asleep.

disguise.short: Prevents the first instance of battle damage.

rks-system.short: Changes this Pokémon's type to match its held Memory.

full-metal-body.short: Other Pokémon cannot lower this Pokémon's stats.

soul-heart.short: This Pokémon's Special Attack rises by one stage every time any Pokémon faints.

dazzling.short: Opposing Pokémon cannot use priority attacks.

misty-surge.short: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Misty Terrain.

beast-boost.short: Raises this Pokémon's highest stat by one stage when it faints another Pokémon.

electric-surge.short: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Electric Terrain.

steelworker.short: This Pokémon's Steel moves have 1.5× power.

punk-rock.short: Boosts sound-based moves and halves damage from the same moves.

sand-spit.short: Creates a sandstorm when hit by an attack.

steam-engine.short: Boosts the Speed stat drastically when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire- or Water-type move.

propeller-tail.short: Ignores moves and abilities that draw in moves.

power-spot.short: Just being next to the Pokémon powers up moves.

steely-spirit.short: Powers up ally Pokémon's Steel-type moves.

libero.short: Libero changes the Pokémon's type to that of its previously used attack.

gulp-missile.short: If a Cramorant with Gulp Missile uses Surf or Dive, it catches prey and changes its form depending on its remaining HP.

perish-body.short: When hit by a move that makes direct contact, the Pokémon and the attacker will faint after three turns unless they switch out of battle.

wandering-spirit.short: Swaps abilities with opponents on contact.

cotton-down.short: When Ignores moves and abilities that draw in moves.

screen-cleaner.short: Nullifies effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil.

ball-fetch.short: If the Pokémon is not holding an item, it will fetch the Poké Ball from the first failed throw of the battle.

ice-face.short: The Pokémon’s ice head can take a physical attack as a substitute, but the attack also changes the Pokémon’s appearance. The ice will be restored when it snows.

purifying-salt.short: Protects from status conditions and halves damage from Ghost-type moves.

seed-sower.short: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.

lingering-aroma.short: Contact changes the attacker's Ability to Lingering Aroma.

electromorphosis.short: When hit by an attack, the power of the next Electric-type move it uses is doubled.

stalwart.short: Ignores moves and abilities that draw in moves.

wind-power.short: When hit by a wind move, the power of the next Electric-type move it uses is doubled.

well-baked-body.short: Immune to Fire-type moves, and Defense is sharply boosted.

chilling-neigh.short: Boosts Attack after knocking out a Pokémon.

unseen-fist.short: Contact moves can strike through Protect/Detect.

grim-neigh.short: Boosts Special Attack after knocking out a Pokémon.

hunger-switch.short: Causes Morpeko to change its form each turn, alternating between Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode

mycelium-might.short: Status moves go last, but are not affected by the opponent's ability.

supreme-overlord.short: Attack and Special Attack are boosted for each party Pokémon that has been defeated.

toxic-debris.short: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.

quark-drive.short: Raises highest stat on Electric Terrain, or if holding Booster Energy.

cud-chew.short: Causes the Pokémon to reuse an already consumed Berry at the end of the next turn.

zero-to-hero.short: Transforms into its Hero Form when switching out.

protosynthesis.short: Raises highest stat in harsh sunlight, or if holding Booster Energy.

guard-dog.short: Boosts Attack if intimidated, and prevents being forced to switch out.

earth-eater.short: Restores HP when hit by a Ground-type move.

costar.short: Copies ally's stat changes on entering battle.

thermal-exchange.short: Raises Attack when hit by a Fire-type move. Cannot be burned.

armor-tail.short: Prevents the opponent from using any moves that have priority, such as Quick Attack.

commander.short: Goes inside the mouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field.

anger-shell.short: When the Pokémon's HP drops below half, Anger Shell lowers its Defense and Special Defense but its Attack, Special Attack and Speed are raised.

opportunist.short: Copies stat boosts by the opponent.

tablets-of-ruin.short: Lowers Attack of all Pokémon except itself.

vessel-of-ruin.short: Lowers Special Attack of all Pokémon except itself.

sword-of-ruin.short: Lowers Defense of all Pokémon except itself.

orichalcum-pulse.short: Turns the sunlight harsh when entering battle, and boosts Attack while active.

hospitality.short: When a Pokémon with Hospitality enters a battle, it restores HP for an ally by 25%.

poison-puppeteer.short: Pokémon poisoned by Pecharunt's moves will also become confused.

tera-shift.short: When Terapagos enters the battle, it turns into its Terastal Form until the end of the battle.

toxic-chain.short: May cause bad poisoning when the Pokémon hits an opponent with a move.

hadron-engine.short: Creates an Electric Terrain when entering battle, and boosts Special Attack while active.

supersweet-syrup.short: Once per battle, when a Pokémon with Supersweet Syrup enters the battle, it lowers the evasion stat of all adjacent opponents by one stage.

beads-of-ruin.short: Lowers Special Defense of all Pokémon except itself.

parental-bond.short: Lets the bearer hit twice with damaging moves. The second hit has half power.

aerilate.short: Turns the bearer's Normal moves into Flying moves and strengthens them to 1.3× their power.

mega-sol.short: The Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.

dragonize.short: The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

delta-stream.short: Creates a mysterious air current, which cannot be replaced and causes moves to never be super effective against Flying Pokémon.

aura-guard.short: A Pokémon with Aura Guard takes half damage from moves that make contact.

piercing-drill.short: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves.

eelevate.short: The Pokémon floats off the ground, making it immune to Ground-type moves, as well as the Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web statuses. When the Pokémon knocks out a target with an attack, its highest stat is boosted by 1 stage.

fire-mane.short: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's Fire-type moves by 50%.

spicy-spray.short: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.

galvanize.short: This Pokémon's Normal moves are Electric and have their power increased to 1.2×.

surge-surfer.short: Doubles this Pokémon's Speed on Electric Terrain.

desolate-land.short: Creates extremely harsh sunlight, which has all the properties of Sunny Day, cannot be replaced, and causes damaging Water moves to fail.

power-construct.short: Transforms 10% or 50% Zygarde into Complete Forme when its HP is below 50%.

tera-shell.short: All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.

battle-bond.short: Transforms this Pokémon into Ash-Greninja after fainting an opponent. Water Shuriken's power is 20 and always hits three times.

tangling-hair.short: When this Pokémon takes regular damage from a contact move, the attacking Pokémon's Speed lowers by one stage.

pastel-veil.short: Prevents the Pokémon and its allies from being poisoned.

primordial-sea.short: Creates heavy rain, which has all the properties of Rain Dance, cannot be replaced, and causes damaging Fire moves to fail.

quick-draw.short: Enables the Pokémon to move first occasionally.
